sloka: राक्षसानां सहस्राणि निहत्य मधुसूदनः ।वारिजं पूरयामास तोयदं सुरराडिव ।। ७.७.२३ ॥
transliteration: rākṣasānāṁ sahasrāṇi nihatya madhusūdanaḥ ।vārijaṁ pūrayāmāsa toyadaṁ surarāḍiva ।। 7.7.23 ॥

translations.english: Having slain thousands of rakshasas, Madhusudana blew his conch, just as the king of gods (Indra) causes a cloud to thunder.
